|notes=The source slip overlays [[Darth Vader]]; its uncovered title, destiny, lore and type remain those of the underlying card.<ref name="host">Uncovered title, destiny, lore, type and icons: [[:File:Premiere-D-darthvader-decipher-archive.gif|original Premiere printed face]].</ref> The underlying face caption is “Darth Vader”; the Premium sheet labels this publication “Darth Vader (V)”. Matching relationships follow the named-character weapon and matching-pilot rules.<ref name="matching-rules">[http://decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Glossary, Version 2.0], [[Decipher]] (November 1998), pp. 13–14 and 90.
